items.detail: The **S&P 500** rose 0.58% to 7,818.93 on Tuesday, its first close above 7,800 and first record since August, while the Nasdaq hit another record at 27,599.79.
items.why: Treasury yields eased from their highest since 2002 and oil slid below $100, and Nvidia neared a $6 trillion value.

items.detail: The **10-year Treasury yield** eased to about 5.27% from Monday's 5.35%, its highest since 2002, giving the rally its first relief from the bond selloff.
items.why: The global bond selloff paused and the dollar pulled back from a one-year high.

items.detail: Next up are the **Fed's September meeting minutes** on Wednesday, the next clue on rate hikes before earnings season starts.
items.why: With yields still near 24-year highs, any hint of another hike could test the new record.

items.detail: MSCI's emerging-market stock index rose for a **second straight day** on Tuesday, with Brazilian assets in demand and South Africa's rand up 0.8%.
items.why: A conservative sweep in Brazil's first-round election, Brent below $100 and a weaker dollar lifted EM assets.

items.detail: The RBI raised its repo rate **25 basis points to 5.5%** on Wednesday, its first hike since 2023, and the Nifty dipped toward 22,650 after Tuesday's 0.98% gain.
items.why: Inflation and a weak rupee forced the hike, but a higher growth forecast of 7.1% limited the selloff.

items.detail: The US **Russell 2000** fell 0.6% to 2,830.30 on Tuesday, ending a three-day winning streak even as the big US indices hit records.
items.why: Small caps gave up early gains despite easier yields as buyers moved into megacap tech instead.

items.detail: **Bitcoin** slipped to about **$85,600**, below Monday's $86,000, after failing again to break $87,000.
items.why: Spot bitcoin ETFs had their first October outflow, $89.8 million, and about $172 million of positions were liquidated.

items.detail: **Ether** held near **$2,705** after the Glamsterdam upgrade launched successfully on the Sepolia testnet on Tuesday.
items.why: Upgrade progress is holding up the price, but ether ETFs posted a third straight outflow of about $51 million.

items.detail: **Solana** is stuck near **$120**, down about 1.6% in a day, staying in a narrow range for a second session.
items.why: With bitcoin stalled below $87,000 and only small Solana ETF inflows, no buyers are pushing it higher.

items.detail: **Spot gold** recovered to about **$4,168** on Tuesday after hitting a two-month low of $4,104 earlier in the session.
items.why: Treasury yields eased from 2002 highs and the dollar fell back from a one-year high, which made bullion cheaper.

crossCuttingTheme: A pause in the global bond selloff, with the 10-year yield easing from its 2002 high and oil below $100, lifted US stocks to records, extended EM gains and pulled gold off two-month lows.
